cohort: The study included 1409 hospitalized newborns from a single tertiary unit, enrolled from January 2018 to September 2020, who had weekly stool cultures performed from birth to discharge.
finding: MDROs and B. cereus were commonly found in the stools of hospitalized neonates, with 7.4% of infants carrying MDROs developing an infection, while no B. cereus carriers developed an infection.
